name: Dovin Baan
description: Dovin Baan is a vedalken planeswalker who sees the flaws in any system, rose to Minister of Inspections in the Consulate of Kaladesh, and later led the Azorius Senate.

summary.text: Dovin Baan is a vedalken planeswalker who sees the flaws in any system, rose to Minister of Inspections in the Consulate of Kaladesh, and later led the Azorius Senate.

bio.text: As the Consulate's Minister of Inspections he sought out the Gatewatch to hunt the renegades, and revealed that Chandra's parents had been hunted and reported dead.
He stood beside Tezzeret when Pia was seized, ordered soldiers to contain Chandra with gearhulks, and later told Baral that Chandra was back.
After Tezzeret's chaotic confiscation, Baan was placed in charge of the confiscated inventions, and ordered a squad to pursue the Gatewatch.
He infiltrated the airship and destroyed the disruptor module of Hope of Ghirapur, then planeswalked away.
He planned the counterattack on the Aether Hub, and arrested Baral.
On Ravnica he became Grand Arbiter of the Azorius Senate and, as its guildmaster, collaborated with Bolas.

status.text: As of the latest story that mentions him, he is the Azorius guildmaster who collaborates with Bolas.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces Dovin Baan, a Minister of Inspections from Kaladesh, as the first to seek out the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Our guest is Dovin Baan.

timeline.summary: Baan presents himself as a representative of the Consulate of Kaladesh and describes its unified system.
timeline.quote: I have the honor of coming before you as an officially and duly designated representative of the Consulate of Kaladesh.

timeline.summary: Baan explains that the Inventors' Fair preparations have been disrupted by vandals.
timeline.quote: preparations have been repeatedly disrupted by vandals and malcontents

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes Baan wants the Gatewatch to provide security and hunt the renegades.
timeline.quote: So, to be clear, you want the Gatewatch to provide...security?

timeline.summary: Chandra storms out of the meeting furious at Baan's description of the renegades.
timeline.quote: Chandra's chair tilted over backward as she bolted to her feet.

timeline.summary: Baan asks who makes decisions for the group, and Jace and Gideon each fumble to name a leader.
timeline.quote: Gideon is the battlefield commander...

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Baan the Gatewatch handles outside threats, not internal ones, so its hands are tied.
timeline.quote: our hands are tied.

timeline.summary: Baan accepts Liliana's reasoning and prepares to leave.
timeline.quote: I did not fully comprehend the strictures you operate under.

timeline.summary: Gideon invites Baan to stay for dinner and a tour of the headquarters.
timeline.quote: Minister, you should at least stay for dinner.

timeline.summary: Chandra rushes past Baan and Gideon, apologizing for blowing up the punching bag.
timeline.quote: SorryIblewupyourthingy

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Baan about what Nissa and Chandra did on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: I was telling Minister Baan what you did on Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Baan contrasts aether with leylines, and Nissa explains that on her world they ask rather than take.
timeline.quote: We don't take.

timeline.summary: Baan voices his deterministic view that a criminal will forever remain a criminal.
timeline.quote: A criminal will forever remain a criminal.

timeline.summary: Baan recognizes Chandra's surname and reveals Pia and Kiran Nalaar were renegade luminaries.
timeline.quote: Pia and Kiran Nalaar were early luminaries of the renegade movement.

timeline.summary: Baan explains that Chandra's parents, hunted after she manifested pyromancy, were reported dead when Bunarat was set ablaze.
timeline.quote: the girl escaped custody when she manifested dangerous pyromantic abilities

timeline.summary: Nissa volunteers to go to Kaladesh with Baan and stand with Chandra.
timeline.quote: I'll stand with her.

timeline.summary: The train stops amid an aether disruption that Chandra attributes to the renegade.
timeline.quote: A disruption. The aftermath of some kind of aerial display.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret, flanked by automatons and Dovin Baan, seizes Pia with his metal claw.
timeline.quote: The hand that gripped her arm was a massive claw of dark metal

timeline.summary: Baan orders the soldiers to isolate and contain the pyromancer with gearhulks.
timeline.quote: Isolate and contain. Gearhulks in the front line

timeline.summary: To protect Chandra, Pia announces herself as the renegade leader and surrenders to Consulate custody.
timeline.quote: My name is Pia Nalaar, leader of the renegades. I'm prepared to enter Consulate custody.

timeline.summary: Baral says Baan told him she was back and promises she will not escape again.
timeline.quote: Baan said you were back. I couldn't believe it.

timeline.summary: Kambal tells the courier to inform Inspector Baan that the bait is set and the confiscation can be prepared.
timeline.quote: Alert Inspector Baan. The bait is set. Prepare the confiscation.

timeline.summary: Baan advises an enforcer how to disable a lifecraft elephant by cutting its exposed cable.
timeline.quote: All that is required is to sever the cable, and the entire automaton will collapse.

timeline.summary: Baan orders the elven lifecrafter taken into custody for the disturbance.
timeline.quote: Take the elf into custody to answer for this disturbance.

timeline.summary: Baan touches Tezzeret's arm and realizes the metal claw is a replacement limb he had not noticed before.
timeline.quote: he realized it was part of the arm

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says the Gatewatch interrupted his duel and disappeared with the renegade.
timeline.quote: I was referring specifically to the gang of six Planeswalkers who interrupted that duel and disappeared with the renegade.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret claims the confiscations are safeguarding the inventions from renegade attack.
timeline.quote: It's not as though we're stealing their inventions. We're safeguarding them.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret snarls that there is no time, then sheds his rage, which Baan notices.
timeline.quote: There's no time

timeline.summary: Tezzeret offers Baan the job of leading Consulate exploration of the confiscated inventions.
timeline.quote: And who better than you to lead that effort?

timeline.summary: Baan explains he invited some Gatewatch planeswalkers as a safeguard, but they refused and only Nissa came.
timeline.quote: I invited some of them here as a safeguard against a potential fault I identified in the plans for the Inventors' Fair

timeline.summary: Tezzeret orders Baan to fix the situation, secure an inquirium for himself and keep the Bastion on alert.
timeline.quote: You need to fix this, Baan.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reveals that Rashmi's work has staggering implications larger than Kaladesh and will be his focus.
timeline.quote: Rashmi's work for the fair had staggering implications.

timeline.summary: Baan orders a veteran squad to pursue the Gatewatch and exploit their weaknesses.
timeline.quote: Exploit those weaknesses in every way you can. Go!

timeline.summary: Baan soothes an angry inventor whose thopter fabricator is being confiscated, assuring him the Consulate is grateful.
timeline.quote: The Consulate is grateful.

timeline.summary: Baan reaches the storage facility where scientists catalog the confiscated inventions, which he now oversees.
timeline.quote: Top scientists and inventors from every Consulate inquirium in the city had been sent here

timeline.summary: Baan plans curfews and tighter aether supply to suppress the renegades while the Gatewatch is captured.
timeline.quote: Increased Bastion presence. Curfews, perhaps.

timeline.summary: Dovin Baan, having exhausted Kaladesh's resources against a self-described renegade, decides to call on the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Dovin sees no other choice but to reach outside his world and call on other Planeswalkers

timeline.summary: Chandra hears from Dovin Baan that Kaladesh is threatened and returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.
timeline.quote: She returns home for the first time since her parents' deaths.

timeline.summary: The cloaked figure is revealed as Tezzeret, who was stalking Pia Nalaar; Chandra and Pia, each thinking the other dead, are shocked, and the Consulate takes Pia prisoner.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret, Dovin, and Consulate enforcers take Pia prisoner, accusing her of leading the renegade threat.

timeline.summary: Dovin Baan infiltrates the airship and destroys the crucial disruptor module of Hope of Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: And just as Chandra recognized it, Dovin crushed it.

timeline.summary: Dovin warns the ship has lost fuel and planeswalks away while Chandra fires blindly.
timeline.quote: He was planeswalking away.

timeline.summary: On Skysovereign, Tezzeret screams at an orderly and Baan challenges the Grand Consul's tactics privately.
timeline.quote: I acknowledge the effectiveness of your harangues at keeping this crew aligned and attentive. I, however, am...unimpressed.

timeline.summary: Baan lays out a pincer-and-airborne plan to retake the Aether Hub, exploiting the Gatewatch's divided leadership and Chandra's rashness.
timeline.quote: Transports loaded with Inspectors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret orders Baral to lure the Nalaars and their friends away from the Hub, adding Baan to Baral's squad.
timeline.quote: Annoy the Nalaars. Lure them away from the Aether Hub.

timeline.summary: Baral and Baan escape the failed trap in a thopter, and the Consulate's next phase begins.
timeline.quote: High above them, the black specks of thopters lifted from the decks of Skysovereign .

timeline.summary: Baan arrests the injured Baral for murder, attempted murder, extrajudicial incarceration and falsifying records.
timeline.quote: Chief Inspector Dhiren Baral, I charge you with one count of murder

timeline.summary: Baan reports the Hub regained and leaves Baral under arrest.
timeline.quote: The Aether Hub has been regained.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag performs poetry and a comedy set mocking Azorius and Dovin Baan, which falls flat when an arrester appears.
timeline.quote: I finish my set anyway—twenty-three minutes of pure torture.

timeline.summary: On the way home Zita fixes graffiti insulting Dovin Baan, and an Azorius arrester arrests her for defacing a building and slandering a Grand Arbiter, with Kodolaag's statement logged against her.
timeline.quote: defacing a public building," he continues, "Plus Azorius code 6342-P, slandering a Grand Arbiter," the arrester says, binding Zita up

timeline.summary: Olrich impersonates Dovin Baan to hold off a soldier, and the trio walks out among exiting visitors.
timeline.quote: Citizens! Behold! It is I, your highly esteemed Grand Arbiter, Protector of Justice, Purveyor of Protocols!

timeline.summary: Reza visits the Old Laws Library, where Tagan tells him the Senate adored his law rune and that Baan called it brilliant.
timeline.quote: They adored it. So intricate. So comprehensive.

timeline.summary: Dovin uses his powers to worm his way into positions of authority where his will can be done.
timeline.quote: He frequently uses his powers to worm his way into positons of authority where his will can be done.

relations.note: He is its designated representative and Minister of Inspections.
relations.quote: I have the honor of coming before you as an officially and duly designated representative of the Consulate of Kaladesh.

relations.note: Chandra calls him one of the Consulate.
He is the Consulate's Minister of Inspections.
relations.quote: the stately vedalken Minister of Inspections himself, Dovin Baan

relations.note: Tezzeret rewards and relies on his foresight.
relations.quote: And Tezzeret had seen his potential as well
The Consulate had recognized his talents, which accounted for his rise to the position of senior inspector

relations.note: He orders a squad to pursue them.
relations.quote: Exploit those weaknesses in every way you can. Go!

relations.note: Senior Consulate inspector in charge of inspection at the Fair.
relations.quote: the Consulate has put him in charge of inspection at the Inventors' Fair

relations.note: He sabotages her plan and is attacked by her.
relations.quote: "My error is now remedied," Dovin said.

relations.note: Baral blames Baan for the inspectors' end.
relations.quote: "It was Baan, wasn't it?" Baral growled.

relations.note: Baan reports to the Grand Consul.
relations.quote: We pay you to see flaws.
I charge you with one count of murder
with my best nasally imitation of Azorius's Grand Arbiter
Dovin Baan, who we've learned is a pawn of Nicol Bolas.

relations.note: The Azorius guildmaster collaborates with the dragon.

pages_say.description: A tall vedalken Minister of Inspections for the Consulate of Kaladesh who asks the Gatewatch to root out renegades threatening the Inventors' Fair and reveals Chandra's parents.
An inspector whose displeasure the arena announcer fears.
A Consulate inspector who sought the Gatewatch's help and whom Chandra calls one of them.
The vedalken Minister of Inspections who accompanies Tezzeret and orders the soldiers to contain Chandra.
A Consulate minister who told Baral that Chandra was back.
The inspector told to prepare the confiscation.
A meticulous vedalken senior inspector of the Consulate who loves the Consulate, tries to repair Tezzeret's chaotic confiscation, and is placed in charge of the confiscated inventions.
A Planeswalker and Senior Consulate inspector who sees every flaw in any system and calls on the Gatewatch.
A Consulate figure who, with Tezzeret, would bring out big weapons against a renegade success.
A vedalken planeswalker and Consulate inspector who sabotages Heart of Kiran and the disruptor, then planeswalks away.
A Consulate inspector who has disappeared, blamed by Baral for the end of the inspectors.
A Consulate minister and inspector who plans the counterattack on the Aether Hub by exploiting the Gatewatch's weaknesses and later arrests Baral.
The Grand Arbiter of the Azorius Senate, mocked by Kodolaag and impersonated by Olrich.
The Grand Arbiter of the Azorius Senate, who praises Reza's law rune.
The Azorius guildmaster who has been working with Bolas and guards the Immortal Sun.
The Azorius guildmaster who collaborates with Bolas.
The Azorius guildmaster who fled Ravnica.
A planeswalker who aided Bolas; Vraska is assigned to hunt him.
A planeswalker who sees the flaws in any system or machine and predicts exactly how and when it will fail.
